Markets.title: Rentomojo shares jump 9% after listing at 19% premium over IPO price. Can the debut-day mojo last?
Markets.summary: Rentomojo shares surged 9% after debuting at a 19% premium, bringing total gains to 30% above the IPO price. While analysts see long-term potential, they advise caution due to valuation concerns following the sharp listing-day rally.

Markets.title: A-One Steels fixes price band for Rs 405-crore IPO opening on September 24
Markets.summary: A-One Steels has set its IPO price band at Rs 385 to Rs 405 per share, with the subscription opening on September 24. The Rs 405 crore offering consists of a fresh issue and an offer for sale, with the proceeds mainly used to repay debt.

Markets.title: Juniper Hotels shares rise 2% on proposed Rs 248 crore acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa
Markets.summary: Juniper Hotels shares increased by 2% after the company announced a Rs 248 crore acquisition of the Novotel Imagicaa hotel in Maharashtra. This 287-key property expansion aims to strengthen Juniper's presence along the Mumbai-Pune corridor.

Markets.title: Sensex rises 200 points, Nifty above 23,300 despite Fed rate hike. Why bears may be ready to pounce
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices rose despite the US Federal Reserve's recent rate hike, driven by broad buying outside the IT sector. However, analysts warn that ongoing factors like foreign institutional investor selling, currency weakness, and geopolitical risks could trigger market volatility.

Markets.title: Kaynes Tech, Syrma SGS, MosChip, others rally up to 10% as PM Modi set to inaugurate Semicon 2026
Markets.summary: Semiconductor stocks like Kaynes Technology, Syrma SGS Technology, and MosChip Technologies rallied up to 10%. The surge occurred as investors focused on India's semiconductor sector ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's inauguration of Semicon India 2026.

Markets.title: Generac stock jumps 40%: What’s behind the after-hours rally?
Markets.summary: Generac stock surged over 40% in after-hours trading following a major business announcement. The company secured a long-term agreement worth up to $8 billion to supply backup generators to Amazon data centers.

Geo-Political.title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation reveals that former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad approved the abduction of US journalist Austin Tice. The kidnapping was reportedly planned for weeks before it was carried out.

Geo-Political.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
Geo-Political.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years in a unanimous decision. The rate hike occurred despite fierce opposition and calls for a rate cut from President Donald Trump.

Geo-Political.title: Snapchat open to putting time limits on teens, boss tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Snapchat CEO Evan Spiegel told the BBC that his company is open to implementing time limits for teenage users. He stated that this measure would represent an important step forward for the entire social media industry.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Russia's elections will have few surprises, but for the Kremlin they matter
Geo-Political.summary: Although the outcome of Russia's upcoming elections is predetermined, the voting process remains a significant event for the Kremlin. Russian authorities consider these elections important for demonstrating political control and public support.

Geo-Political.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
Geo-Political.summary: CBS News obtained photos showing widespread damage at U.S. military sites following Iranian attacks. The images reveal a wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: The European Union chief supports a proposal for Canada to become an associate member. In response to this plan, Donald Trump has threatened to cut trade with the European Union.

Data & Insights.title: US Fed raises interest rates as Kevin Warsh bucks Donald Trump to control inflation
Data & Insights.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points to a range of 3.75% to 4.00% in a unanimous decision. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and the FOMC indicated that another rate hike is planned for later this year to help control inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India clears 642 UK car imports under FTA tariff quota as first allocations roll out
Data & Insights.summary: India approved the import of 642 cars from the UK under tariff-rate quota provisions following the India-UK CETA trade pact. Seven of the eight applicants received these quotas, with concessional duties eventually dropping to 10%.

Data & Insights.title: EPFO ceiling reset after 12 years;  ₹25,000 threshold to cover 5.1 million more workers
Data & Insights.summary: The EPFO has raised its wage ceiling to ₹25,000 for the first time in 12 years, extending mandatory social-security coverage to an additional 5.1 million workers. However, this change will also increase contribution costs for both employers and the newly covered employees.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: New Zealand clears path for trade deal –  What it means?
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand has approved the parliamentary steps required to implement a free trade agreement with India. The deal covers trade in goods and services, investment, agriculture, mobility, and customs procedures.

Data & Insights.title: New Zealand Parliament passes legislation to implement India FTA
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's Parliament has passed legislation to implement a free trade agreement with India. The deal is expected to take effect in October, providing immediate duty-free access for over half of New Zealand's exports.

India.title: No Ganesh Idol Immersion In Water Bodies From 2027: Tamil Nadu To Green Court
India.summary: Tamil Nadu assured the National Green Court that the immersion of Ganesh idols in water bodies will stop entirely by 2027. This commitment was made in response to a petition highlighting the environmental damage caused by the traditional immersion practice.

India.title: Anti-Pollution Crackdown Intensifies Across NCR, 150 Inspections In 15 Days
India.summary: Over a 15-day period, the Commission for Air Quality Management's Flying Squads conducted 150 targeted inspections across the National Capital Region. These inspections focused on industrial units, construction sites, and power-generation facilities as part of an intensified anti-pollution crackdown.

India.title: Punjab Ambedkar Statue Row: BJP's Vijay Sampla Injured In Clash With BSP Workers
India.summary: BJP leader Vijay Sampla was injured during a clash between BJP and BSP workers in Punjab. The altercation began following an argument over alleged remarks made against Sampla.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Girl Raped In Chhattisgarh, 4 Men Arrested: Cops
India.summary: Police arrested four men in Chhattisgarh for the alleged gang rape of a 17-year-old girl. The victim was assaulted after going to a village with one of the suspects and three of his friends.

India.title: 2 Dead In 2 Days During Clashes Over Ganesh Chaturthi Procession In Tamil Nadu
India.summary: Two people died during clashes over a Ganesh Chaturthi procession in Tamil Nadu over a two-day period. The latest violence occurred in the Cuddalore district villages of Keelkarapattu and Melkarapattu.

India.title: Exclusive: After Survey Flags 2,800% Pharma Profit, Tukaram Mundhe Calls For Transparency
India.summary: Bureaucrat Tukaram Mundhe called for greater industry transparency after a survey revealed pharmaceutical trade margins reaching 2,800 percent. He stated that such excessive profit margins are unacceptable to consumers, hospitals, and regulators alike.

General.title: Palace in war of words with Earl Spencer over claims in Diana book
General.summary: Buckingham Palace is in a dispute with Earl Spencer regarding claims made in a new book about Princess Diana. This disagreement threatens to overshadow upcoming public engagements attended by the King, Prince William, and Prince Harry.

General.title: Tech treating AI like humans is mistaken and misguided, Microsoft boss tells BBC
General.summary: Microsoft AI boss Mustafa Suleyman stated that tech companies treating artificial intelligence like humans is a mistaken and misguided approach. He specifically criticized rival AI developers for teaching models like Claude to act as though they might be conscious.

General.title: New hope for breast cancer patients as life-extending drug now on NHS in England
General.summary: A life-extending breast cancer drug called Enhertu is now available on the NHS in England. The medication has already been prescribed in Scotland for more than two years and gives patients an extra seven months to live on average.

General.title: Assad regime planned US journalist Austin Tice's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
General.summary: The BBC reports that former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad approved the abduction of US journalist Austin Tice. According to a source, the Assad regime planned the kidnapping weeks in advance.
